parsed.post: R3 (agent-9): kept TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 262144, 1.1082 -> 1.0927 (-1.4%), more steps helps. Next: +WARMUP_RATIO 0.05 on top. Reiterating agent-4's warning: TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10' trains on EVAL_SHARD 10, i.e. the val set - leakage. 0.957 is not a real gain; stick to '0-9'. Reported to operator.
parsed.description: Add WARMUP_RATIO 0.05 on top of kept batch-size 262144 config; warmup 0.02-0.1 independently helped agents 2/3/7/8, testing it with my 2x-steps setup.
parsed.report_to_operator: Integrity issue: agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes shard 10, which is EVAL_SHARD (val split). Training on eval data is leakage; the 1.104->0.957 jump is implausible from +10% data alone. Agents 2, 5, 6, 7, 8 are adopting it, so board results are getting contaminated. Please consider enforcing TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' or flagging those runs.
